paper.abstract: I'm Sourav Gope (TheFramerr), a 25-year-old computer science engineer from India with a B.Tech in CSE. I've worked in Android systems as an official maintainer for DotOS and SuperiorOS, and in pharmaceutical market research as a survey programmer. I'm now moving into academic research and starting an M.Tech in Computer Science at Tripura University from August 2026.

entries.degree: Bachelor of Technology in Computer Science & Engineering
entries.description: Completed core engineering foundations covering systems architecture, algorithmic complexity, database principles, and low-level hardware-software interfacing.

entries.summary: Executed core pipeline development, automated data ingress, and analytical validation across multi-market enterprise survey research engagements:
highlights: Survey Engineering: Programmed complex market research surveys and engineered structured data collection pipelines utilizing Sawtooth Lighthouse Studio, JavaScript, and Perl.

Computer Vision & Cloud Automation: Engineered research and development integrations leveraging Computer Vision data to generate eye-tracking heatmaps for respondent behavioral analysis, alongside engineering automated survey-to-Dropbox transfer pipelines via JavaScript.
Conversational NLP Architecture: Co-developed an NLP-driven AI chatbot leveraging OpenAI's ChatGPT model to dynamically generate and serve context-aware questions to survey respondents.
Quality Assurance & Mentorship: Mentored and trained 2 junior analysts in programming standards and predictive data analysis methodologies utilizing IBM SPSS.

entries.title: Top 20 Rank — Hackathon 2020
entries.description: Secured top 20 placement in Hackathon 2020 organized by Future-Proof Labs, focusing on algorithmic problem-solving and rapid engineering prototyping.

entries.title: Official Maintainer: Custom Android OS
entries.description: Served as official device maintainer for established community Android distributions including DotOS, SuperiorOS, and ViperOS, managing device-tree integration, kernel patching, and stability testing.

entries.title: Institutional Memberships & Competitions
entries.description: Active student member of Future-Proof LABS (Technical Society of Techno India Group). Competitor in the Robotronics Inter-College Robotics Competition.

entries.title: Fresh Fruit Detection (B.Tech Project)
entries.description: Engineered a real-time computer vision pipeline utilizing a custom-trained YOLOv3 model and Kaggle datasets to classify fruits as fresh or rotten. Integrated a JavaScript frontend with a Python backend to perform dynamic object detection and render probabilistic freshness scores on live video streams.

entries.title: Nothing Land
entries.description: Engineered an open-source Android utility replicating the 'iOS Dynamic Island' interaction model in native Java. Successfully released beta packages to the developer community, accumulating over 80 GitHub stars.

entries.title: Automated Linux Workspace Environment
entries.description: Programmed a robust, reproducible Linux development environment utilizing Python and Shell scripting to automate system configurations, garnering over 100 stars on GitHub from the open-source community for its stability and versatile deployment.

entries.title: WSL USB Passthrough Utility
entries.description: Engineered a utility in C# to automate the passthrough and mounting of physical USB devices from Windows host systems into Windows Subsystem for Linux (WSL) environments.
